_doc: Bundle-size budgets enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budgets.mjs. Sizes are uncompressed bytes of JS+CSS in internal/frontendassets/dist. Run `npm run bundle:check` after `npm run build` locally; CI runs it automatically (.github/workflows/ci.yml frontend-ci job). When a legitimate growth lands, bump the relevant budget in the same PR and explain why in the commit message.

total._doc: Hard ceiling for the entire dist tree. Baseline measured 2026-05-26 = 1235 KB; budget sits at 1300 KB for the immediate v0.40 line. M4 (frontend code-split) is expected to TIGHTEN this, not loosen it.

voiceagent-bundle._doc: Chunks that load only when the Voice-Agent UI mounts: the audio-level visualisers (bar + radial), the aura orb, and the VA prompter. v0.40 M4 made these dynamic-imported from overlay-surfaces and decoupled the bar visualiser from LiveKit so the overlay entry's static graph excludes LiveKit.

core-dictation-shell._doc: Everything else: the control-plane SPA shell, settings dashboard, overlay surfaces, dictate-mode UI, shared React runtime. This is the budget that protects the 'Dictation-only is lean' claim. Baseline ~669 KB pre-M4, ~672 KB after M4 (utils + preload-helper now show as separate chunks).
